note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web for Amite County MS zoning districts. No county zoning layer is published as a queryable service; the county parcel viewer (amitems.maps.arcgis.com) shows parcels, not districts. Zoning inside the towns of Liberty and Gloster is municipal; no published MS zoning district service found for either. The only Liberty zoning map found (gis-liberty.hub) is Liberty, Missouri, not Liberty, MS. Commercial parcel aggregators (Regrid) carry zoning codes but are not official queryable sources. The statewide MS_Parcels_2023 service requires a token.
